# Knights — Legion Commander / Chaos Knight

Knights are the meta's "boringly reliable" comp — a 6 Troll / 4 Knight board
that is rarely the strongest thing in the lobby but is almost never the weakest,
so it top-threes over and over as long as it isn't contested. This guide covers
both the standard build and its flashier variant: a raid-boss Legion Commander
that scales her attack damage permanently, game after game.

## The raid-boss Legion Commander

Legion Commander has two permanent-scaling hooks that make her a novelty carry:

- Every home battle she **survives**, she gains +10 attack damage forever (it
  carries through fusions, and stacks across multiple copies on the board).
- Paired with the **Pavise** neutral item, dropping below 50% HP has a high
  chance to permanently add +1 armour to the item.

Feed her a win streak, Blink Dagger so she can retaliate in the backline (her
passive lifesteals off counterattacks), and she snowballs into 250-300+ bonus
damage and ~19 armour by the late game. She is one-dimensional — pure physical —
so pair her with the standard knight core rather than relying on her alone.

## Why the Wizard trick works

Both signature tiers are one piece short of natural, so 2 Wizards do the lifting:
the Wizard perk lowers race/class skill requirements by 1. **5 Trolls + 2
Wizards = the 6-Troll attack-speed stacking tier**, and the same wizards push
your knights to the 4-Knight shield tier. Rubick and Dark Willow are the wizards
(Dark Willow doubles as evasion bait).

## Core Units

| Unit | Cost | Tags |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Legion Commander | 3 | Human, Knight (scaling carry) |
| Chaos Knight | 2 | Demon, Knight (two-shots the front) |
| Luna | 2 | Elf, Knight (AoE damage) |
| Batrider | 2 | Knight, Troll (bridges both bonuses) |
| Dazzle | 1 | Priest, Troll (the real MVP) |
| Witch Doctor | 1 | Troll, Warlock |
| Huskar | 3 | Troll, Warrior |
| Shadow Shaman | 1 | Shaman, Troll |
| Rubick | 3 | God, Wizard |
| Dark Willow | 1 | Elf, Wizard |

Three-star **Dazzle** is the piece that makes the whole comp work — Shadow Grave
gives your carries a few seconds of invulnerability, which is what lets three-
star Chaos Knight and Luna clean up. Prioritize three-starring Dazzle, Luna, and
Chaos Knight.

## Items

- **Blink Dagger + Pavise + Boots** on Legion Commander early; upgrade to
  **Battle Fury** (cuts through armour — essential vs Goblins) and **Aegis of
  Immortal** so she survives to keep scaling.
- **Maelstrom** and offensive items on Luna; **defensive** items (Pipe of
  Insight, Vanguard) on Chaos Knight.
- **Pipe of Insight** is the cheap answer to mage lobbies — no need for Naga.

## Leveling / Roll Plan

The standard knight line stays on **level 5** and rolls for cheap trolls/knights
from round 15 (three humans early is a nice XP bonus). Roll to three-star your
core, then after round 26 push to level 9 for 6 Trolls + 4 Knights. The Legion
Commander variant leans into a win streak and levels a bit higher for her
survival triggers. Knights are strongest roughly round 20-35; after 35 they fall
off unless you've itemized for it, so buy your damage tier-4s in that window.

## Positioning / Matchup Notes

Angle the knights into a sharp corner so they focus-fire single targets; keep
four trolls together for the attack-speed aura. Chaos Knight and Dazzle up front.
Blink Legion Commander onto the backline, but reposition her *away* from tanky
tier-5 carries (e.g. a Satanic Snapfire) so she kills everything else instead of
wasting the fight on one unit. Watch for Priests (they mind-control your Luna or
Chaos Knight) and pure-damage Goblins (bring Battle Fury / Radiance to answer
their armour). Ultra-late, you can go 6 Knights + 6 Trolls at level 11 if you
find the Legendary Only Knight and Troll Warlord.
